description: Defines the 'game' class and related structures for managing game state, players, and commands in the Wesnoth game server.

classes.name: game
classes.description: Manages game state, players, commands, and game logic for Wesnoth server.

classes.name: game_id_matches
classes.description: Predicate for matching game by ID.

methods.name: game
methods.description: Constructor initializing game with player info.

methods.name: is_owner
methods.description: Checks if a player is the owner.

methods.name: is_member
methods.description: Checks if a player is a member.

methods.name: is_needed
methods.description: Checks if a player is needed.

methods.name: is_observer
methods.description: Checks if a player is an observer.

methods.name: filter_commands
methods.description: Filters commands sent by a player based on permissions.

methods.name: take_side
methods.description: Assigns a side to a player.

methods.name: describe_slots
methods.description: Sets description to number of slots; returns true if changed.

methods.name: player_is_banned
methods.description: Checks if a player is banned.

methods.name: send_data
methods.description: Sends data to clients, optionally excluding one.

methods.name: send_data_team
methods.description: Sends data to a specific team.

methods.name: level_init
methods.description: Checks if level data is initialized.

methods.name: process_commands
methods.description: Processes game commands and updates state.

methods.name: player_on_team
methods.description: Checks if a player is on a specific team.
